decisions.reason: The allocated-budget changes are independent clauses already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the schedule-field change requires no additional budget update.
The 154Q-to-201 relationship is already represented from the same message and is not changed further by the service dates.
The explicit four-week requirement and observed incorrect value are already represented from the same message; the date updates require no additional weeks-served Event.
The same message already records the explicit four-week value for Site 154Q/201, while the new dates alone do not establish a session count, rate, or labor-total change.
The source does not mention or necessarily extend the signature requirement to the newly discussed sites.
The source supplies new allocated budgets and dates but does not establish a subcontract amount difference or require an explanatory statement for either new site.

The request to handle the two new budgets may extend the prior salary-and-wages support-sheet deliverable to FCC/FH and Site 154Q/201, but the source does not explicitly identify that artifact and could refer only to the stated agreement-field corrections.
